column1: # SSF2 X68000 external-MIDI preprocessing and loop coordinates.
# source_* values address the unmodified 48 kHz stereo SC-55 FLAC.  Each
# render starts with a stable signed-s16 DC pedestal; the builder validates
# dc_left/dc_right, subtracts it, then discards trim_samples from the start.
# down to the 32-sample ADX grid.  This retains the MIDI-authored loop period
# and one genuine second-pass tail for the CPS+ crossfade.  A dash in all four
# loop fields designates an authored one-shot.  Evidence measured 2026-08-31.
